definitions.overlap: At least one valid actor-support pixel in outward rectangle of projected8corners, including partial-raster rectangles. Weak2D silhouette support, not3D occupancy.
definitions.no_unknown_footprint: Same positive overlap but entire rectangle is valid/in-raster and has no UNKNOWN pixels. Conservative mat envelopes can also cover real actor pixels, so this is not a ground-truth visibility classifier.
definitions.nominal_actor: Existing corrected black|grey TRAIN labels; remaining bag-label boundary errors are preserved and disclosed.
definitions.W64: Exact frozen64-native-pixel support; padding can support nonactor volume.
definitions.unknown: Independent visibility/invalid/out-of-raster status, never converted to a positive or negative material label.

limitations: Low or zero support is not ground-truth empty; hidden real geometry and label errors may lack positive evidence.
Nominal floor height band is a coordinate region, not a fitted floor plane.
Ray coverage under hypothetical support thresholds is separate from actor-surface retention.
